title: have you been in this restaurant before?
content: i’ve been coming here often over the past 3 years or so. it’s an italian restaurant, specifically in this cute hallmark movie type town and it’s always night time outside, so it’s never this sunny in there lol. there’s also almost always a night market going on outside or nearby. it’s close to a fishing dock or sometimes even close to a cliff by the beach. most of the time, it’s sprinkling outside too. i’m also only inside after hours.
